title: For a smooth morphism the conormal sequence of a commutative triangle of morphisms is short exact
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a composite of morphisms with the first one smooth, the conormal sequence relating the pulled back differentials of the base, the differentials of the composite and the relative differentials of the second morphism is short exact (statement lines 7406-7414). The counted proof is short and complete: it names the algebraic statement for ring maps with a smooth second map, which is exactly the missing exactness at the left term of the sequence already known to be exact at the other terms (proof lines 7416-7426). It is H2: the reduction is carried out in the counted span and the cited input is the corresponding algebraic exactness statement, so the content is the identification rather than a long argument.
